title: somethingwithproof
tagline: Monitoring, infrastructure and editing tools, with the evidence attached.
intro: Each project page separates what ships from what is proposed, links the source it depends on, and lists its open questions.

sections.name: Monitoring
sections.blurb: Cacti plugins, work on Cacti core and Spine, the RRDtool graphing stack, and standalone Nagios and SNMP agents.

topics.name: Cacti plugins
topics.blurb: Plugins for Cacti 1.2. The HPC set (GPU, Redfish, fabric, parallel filesystems, schedulers) is designed together so its graphs sit on the same devices under Cacti permissions, Thold and Maint.

topics.name: Plugin design documents
topics.blurb: The design plans, specifications and reference documents behind the Cacti plugins, published from each repository's docs/ folder.

pages.name: GPU plugin plan
pages.summary: Plan for per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature, power, ECC, XID and throttling data from NVIDIA and AMD tools, with each GPU as a data query index on its node.

pages.name: Redfish and IPMI plugin plan
pages.summary: Plan for reading power draw, temperatures, fans and power supply health from server BMCs over Redfish, with IPMI as a fallback.

pages.name: InfiniBand fabric plugin plan
pages.summary: Plan for InfiniBand port counters, link width and speed downgrades, and congestion indicators as Cacti devices and graphs.

pages.name: Parallel filesystem plugin plan
pages.summary: Plan for capacity, fill imbalance, per-target throughput and metadata rates, starting with Lustre, then GPFS and BeeGFS.

pages.name: HPC scheduler plugin plan
pages.summary: Plan for queue depth, pending reasons, node states and partition utilization, starting with Slurm, then PBS and LSF.

pages.name: Cloud plugin plan
pages.summary: Plan for bringing resources and metrics from DigitalOcean, AWS, Google Cloud and Azure into Cacti through one plugin.

pages.name: SmokePing plugin plan
pages.summary: Plan for SmokePing latency and loss as Cacti devices and smoke graphs, alertable with Thold and Maint.

pages.name: Installing the SmokePing plugin
pages.summary: From a Cacti 1.2 host and a SmokePing install to graphs in Cacti, including read-only access to SmokePing's data directory.

pages.name: Cloudflare plugin requirements
pages.summary: The requirements source for the Cloudflare plugin: the original brief with the owner's amendments applied.

pages.name: Cloudflare plugin security controls
pages.summary: The security controls implemented through milestone 3, with the code that enforces each one.

pages.name: Cloudflare API token permissions
pages.summary: The read-only, scoped token permissions the plugin needs. Global API keys are refused.

pages.name: Cloudflare plugin metrics
pages.summary: The tunnel metrics the plugin graphs, and how stored discovery data becomes one observation per metric.

pages.name: Cloudflare plugin database schema
pages.summary: The plugin's tables, columns and migrations.

pages.name: Cloudflare collector protocol
pages.summary: What the script server data query accepts and prints, and what any engine writing the plugin tables must provide.

pages.name: Cloudflare plugin compatibility
pages.summary: Supported Cacti and PHP versions, what is tested, and the external interfaces the plugin depends on.
